title: Front-Running Protection for Distributed Exchanges using Tamper-Resistant Round Trip Time Measurements
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical algorithm (ODIN) for preventing front-running in decentralized financial exchanges. While front-running is an unethical practice in finance, the paper's scope is purely technical, describing and evaluating a system's performance and security. It does not engage in a broader analysis of ethics, morals, or any religious or faith-based concepts.
